name: Seishin Seiai Paraphilia
original_name: 精神性愛パラフィリア
source:
A shy and gloomy man does the girl of his love in his mind.

Souta is aggressive in his nature, but outwardly he behaves weak and awkward. Having no friend, his favorite place in his school is the school library where he can see Izumi from a distance.

One day, when he went to the library as usual, his eyes chanced on a book that was left open on a desk.
The book has a mysterious power to slip into the mind of others.
From that night, he starts diving into the mind of Izumi to savor and destroy her from within...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE111700.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个害羞而阴郁的男人在脑海中对心爱的女孩为所欲为。

宗太本性具有攻击性，但表面上表现得软弱而笨拙。没有朋友的他，在学校最喜欢的地方就是图书馆，在那里他可以远远地看到泉。

某天，当他像往常一样去图书馆时，他的目光偶然落在桌上摊开的一本书上。
那本书拥有潜入他人心灵的神秘力量。
从那天晚上起，他开始潜入泉的内心，从内部品味和摧毁她……
